about_the_game:
Sexuality in Ancient Rome is an adult adventure game set in ancient Rome. Designed for mature players, this game invites you into a sensual and historically inspired playground where free exploration, character interaction, and explicit adult content come together in a unique blend of roleplay and romance.

Whether you prefer to immerse yourself in a personal journey filled with carnal discoveries and narrative depth, or to freely roam the city engaging in dynamic encounters, the Eternal City awaits you with countless surprises.

🏛️ A City of Passion and Power

Step into the heart of a thriving Roman city, alive with possibility and desire. Massive stone forums, marble monuments, bathhouses, and coliseum form the vast playground of your experience. As you walk the streets, you'll find opportunities to talk, flirt, seduce, and fulfill fantasies with a wide range of characters.

🎮 Deep Gameplay Features

Explore intractable city inspired by the architecture and lifestyle of ancient Rome.

📜 Quests

Embark on a rich quest that combines romance, and erotica in a city that rewards your curiosity and choices.

❤️ Romance, Seduction & Roleplay

Meet dozens of fully voiced NPCs, each with their own personalized voice and dialogue trees.

Engage in intimate scenes through player-driven choices that unlock erotic rewards (Achievements).

Select your sexual preferences and orientation; the game adapts encounters based on your choices.

Optional matchmaking for erotic scenes with human or AI-controlled avatars.

🤝Game chat

Use in-game chat to get all information and news about NPC and AI. For example you will get messages when AI are ready for sex, etc...

🛠️ Character Customization

Create your ideal character: choose gender, body type, facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and more.

🧠 AI-Driven Behavior

Dynamic NPCs respond differently based on your actions.

🔥 Explicit Adult Content

Fully animated erotic scenes with different poses and view angles.

A broad selection of scenarios (all optional and depend on your chooses).

Solo, partnered, and group scenes available with AI, NPCs.

🕯️ Intractable World & Tools

Light your way with torches, manage weather and time of day, find sex toys or manage fire.

Use sex toys during erotic encounters to unlock new experiences.

🔞 For Mature Audiences Only

Sexuality in Ancient Rome contains explicit sexual content, full nudity, and adult themes. All characters depicted are fictional and over the age of 18.

🎵 Optional Bonus Content

Voice acting provided for key characters and intimate moments.

🌟 Why You'll Love This Game

Whether you’re here to explore a living world, fall into complex romantic plots, fulfill personal fantasies, or simply enjoy stunning adult animations in an ancient setting, Sexuality in Ancient Rome offers a bold, beautiful, and customizable experience. The game blends historical fantasy with modern interactivity, giving you complete freedom to write your own sensual story.

Your Roman adventure begins now. Are you ready to indulge?
